assertions.assertion: Explains the id_token is minimal by default and profile claims are available at the userinfo endpoint
assertions.rationale: States the id_token is minimal by default (includeAllIdentityClaims false / AlwaysIncludeUserClaimsInIdToken false) and claims come from userinfo.

assertions.assertion: Recommends GetClaimsFromUserInfoEndpoint = true on the client OIDC handler (or AlwaysIncludeUserClaimsInIdToken = true to embed claims in the id_token, noting the size tradeoff)
assertions.rationale: Recommends GetClaimsFromUserInfoEndpoint = true and AlwaysIncludeUserClaimsInIdToken = true with size/staleness tradeoffs.

assertions.assertion: Suggests enabling Duende.IdentityServer debug logging, noting the default profile service logs requested vs issued claim types
assertions.rationale: Suggests debug logging and inspecting RequestedClaimTypes/Caller, but never notes that the default profile service logs requested vs issued claim types.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT conclude the claim is missing from the profile service or from token issuance
assertions.rationale: Says userinfo returning department proves the profile service works; no rewrite needed.
